scripts.dev:free-ports: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ports=@(8080,5173); foreach($p in $ports){ $conns=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($c in $conns){ try { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction Stop } catch {} } }; Write-Host 'Cleared dev ports if occupied.'"
scripts.dev:banner: node -e "console.log('========================================'); console.log('Customs RMS Dev URLs'); console.log('Frontend: http://localhost:5173'); console.log('Backend : http://localhost:8080'); console.log('========================================');"
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:free-ports && npm run dev:banner && node scripts/dev-with-env.js
